contradiction_hunter.empirical_finding: Biological literature contains pervasive subtle contradictions, non-linear dose responses, and conditional epistasis. In Benchmark A, Plain Gemini missed the biphasic dose-kinetics of eATP (<10 uM promotes growth, >50 uM inhibits growth). In Benchmark B, Plain Gemini missed that GR24 can stimulate root hair elongation in ethylene-insensitive mutants (ein2-1/etr1-1) under specific nutrient regimes.
failure_modes_detected: Assumption of strictly linear epistatic pathways
Confirmation bias toward initial positive hypotheses
redesign_directives: Mandate explicit multi-concentration and biphasic keyword queries
Require dual-pathway epistasis verification for hormone crosstalk
Enforce that CONTRADICTION_LEDGER must be populated before CLAIM_LEDGER can advance to APPROVED

graphify_boundary.empirical_finding: Evaluated across 13 primary plant signaling PDFs (162 pages). The extracted knowledge graph (14 nodes, 54 edges) achieved 65% precision (13/20 edges resolvable in primary text; 35% were false positives, coincidental co-occurrences, or over-generalized assertions).
graphify_boundary.epistemic_rule: Knowledge graph edges are strictly heuristic navigational aids. They CANNOT serve as proof in EVIDENCE_LEDGER. Every relationship must be traced back to exact PDF page and sentence locations before admission.
redesign_directives: Demarcate graph queries as exploratory leads only
Automate PDF text extraction and quote grounding prior to ledger registration
Flag edges lacking direct sentence co-occurrence as UNVERIFIED_GRAPH_HYPOTHESIS

claim_ledger.empirical_finding: Atomic claim decomposition prevents compound claim pollution where an unverified assertion piggybacks on a well-known scientific fact.
failure_modes_detected: Compound assertions combining authentic biosynthesis genes with hallucinated receptor cascades
Narrative drift between introduction and discussion
redesign_directives: Enforce atomic claim formatting (single subject, single predicate, single condition)
Track lifecycle state: PROPOSED -> EVIDENCE_GATHERED -> CONTRADICTION_CHECKED -> APPROVED
Block manuscript compilation if any cited claim has status FATAL_CONTRADICTION

citation_auditor.empirical_finding: Plain Gemini exhibited a catastrophic 77.8% citation failure rate across Benchmarks A & B (60% HTTP 404 broken DOIs; 40% wrong-identity DOIs pointing to unrelated Drosophila papers). Furthermore, Plain Gemini missed an official Nature Corrigendum published for Jiang et al. (2013).
failure_modes_detected: HTTP 200 false security (DOI exists in Crossref but belongs to completely wrong organism/paper)
Silent omission of published retractions, errata, and corrigenda
Pre-publication manuscript ID hallucination instead of final catalog DOI
redesign_directives: Enforce METADATA_MATCH via title/author fuzzy matching against Crossref API responses
Automate scanning of Crossref 'update-to' array for corrigenda and retractions
Automate fallback queries against Europe PMC and DataCite when Crossref DOI is missing

hostile_reviewer.empirical_finding: Adversarial review caught fatal methodological errors in the Control arm, including pseudoreplicated ANOVA ignoring cluster variance (ICC = 0.536) and over-generalized causal statements.
failure_modes_detected: Self-congratulatory LLM bias when evaluating own manuscripts
Failure to inspect degrees of freedom and variance partitioning
redesign_directives: Implement strict role-based adversarial prompt with zero prior empathy
Enforce numeric scoring across all 12 rubric dimensions with penalty multipliers for fatal defects

quarto_pipeline.empirical_finding: Quarto 1.10 cleanly rendered complex scientific manuscripts containing embedded R/Python calculations, high-resolution figures, LaTeX equations, and BibTeX citations to both HTML and DOCX.
failure_modes_detected: Pandoc silently dropping citations when keys do not exactly match references.bib
PowerShell UTF-8 BOM encoding breaking Rscript execution
redesign_directives: Run Verify-ManuscriptConsistency.py as a mandatory pre-render hook
Enforce BOM-free UTF-8 file writes across all PowerShell automation scripts

r_mixed_models.empirical_finding: In agricultural and biological trials, blocking factors typically explain 30-60% of total variance (ICC = 0.536 in Benchmark C). Plain LLMs default to naive unblocked ANOVA, severely violating independence assumptions.
failure_modes_detected: Type I error inflation due to pseudoreplication
Underestimation of treatment precision due to unpartitioned block variance
redesign_directives: Embed automated ICC calculation in experimental design auditor
Default to R lme4 + lmerTest + emmeans for any multi-block or longitudinal trial
Enforce reporting of Satterthwaite degrees of freedom and Tukey HSD contrasts

bioconductor.empirical_finding: R 4.6.1 on Windows natively supports DESeq2, limma, edgeR, and GEOquery. In the absence of a working WSL2 Linux aligner stack (ext4.vhdx missing), Bioconductor provides complete downstream RNA-seq differential expression capability.
failure_modes_detected: Laptop memory exhaustion when attempting full-genome alignment in WSL2
redesign_directives: Classify raw alignment (STAR/HISAT2) as dataset-dependent / cloud-offloaded
Standardize count-matrix processing, normalization, and contrast testing in native R/Bioconductor
